MODULO = 1000000007

def compute_power(base, exp):
    res = 1
    for _ in range(exp):
        res = (res * base) % MODULO
    return res

def find_value(p, k):
    if k <= 1:
        return compute_power(p, p - 1 + k)
    cycle = 1
    val = k
    while val != 1:
        val = (val * k) % p
        cycle += 1
    return compute_power(p, (p - 1) // cycle)

p, k = map(int, input().split())
print(find_value(p, k))
